verses.text: Behold, bless ye the LORD|strong="H3068" , all ye* servants of the LORD|strong="H3068" , which by night stand in the house of the LORD|strong="H3068" .
Lift up your hands in* the sanctuary, and bless the LORD|strong="H3068" .
The LORD|strong="H3068" that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
